usedFor: Userflow knows who signs up and Sangam CRM works the leads, so “User Created” runs “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “User Created” in Userflow, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM

watchOut: “Create or Update Lead” updates by ID, email or phone, so confirm the Userflow user carries one of them.
